GO s approving cost associated with New High Court construction
The aggregate amount w.r.t. the sanctions provided vide the two Government orders is Rs. 1,342.06 crore, to this, if we add the amount pertaining to reimbursable, we arrive that the figures of Rs. 1,480  crores

It is pertinent to mention that this amount relates to only the tenders already issued, we are given to understand that for completion of the construction, more tenders are to be issued.
